utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Thursday 19 November. Can you all hear me on this thing?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yeah, loud and clear. Anyone watch the football last night? Honestly, ninety minutes I'm not getting back.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: You say that every week, though. Still watch it.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: More entertaining than sitting here discussing the heating in the portakabin. It's either tropical or absolutely Baltic.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: You've still got your coat on. That answers that.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, before this becomes the weather forecast. What's finished, then what's actually on the list?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: I tested the Injection Moulding Line 3 yesterday and it's all fine now. That's finished, nothing further off that test.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Lovely. So that's a proper done, not a nearly done?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: A proper done. You're allowed to have one occasionally.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And I signed off the inspection on the palletiser on Tuesday. That's closed as well; not another inspection for today.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah so, separate bit of maintenance: I'll grease and check the bearings on the Line 3 Screw and Barrel on Friday.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Callum. On Friday for that, then.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yep, I'll do both, grease and bearing check.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Nice to hear the full name. Usually it's just 'that bit over there' with someone pointing off camera.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Jamie, can you sort the training records for the new starters tomorrow at 9:30? Low priority.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Tomorrow at 9:30, rather than today?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yes, tomorrow at 9:30. It's low priority, not something to drag everything else out of the way for.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Fine, I'll sort the training records for the new starters then.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: While I'm on, still waiting on parts for the line 1 mould temp. Nothing we can do until they arrive.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Right, that's still blocked, not work we're pretending we can get through today.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Exactly. Also, heard a slight rattle from the Cooling Tower, nothing to action yet. Just an observation.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Could have been my teeth chattering from in here.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Very good. Observation only, no action off that.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Marc, can you run a function test on the Compressed Air Dryer this morning? Top priority please.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll run the function test this morning. Top of my list.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Sorry, talking over you—function test only? Not rolling the sensor recalibration into that?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Separate jobs. Marcus Hale, can you recalibrate the sensors on the Compressed Air Dryer on Monday? That one's normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Full name, blimey. Yes, I'll recalibrate the sensors on the Compressed Air Dryer on Monday, normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Okay, so the recalibration isn't being pulled into this morning.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: No. Function test this morning, recalibration Monday. Two separate bits.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And Marc, can you run the monthly fire alarm test today at 2pm? It matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yep, I'll run the monthly fire alarm test today at 2pm. Got that.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: The bit of the day when you discover how loud your headset really is.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Oh, on alarms—we were going to replace the belt on the Fire Alarm Panel but that's been pushed to next month, so ignore it. That's off today's list.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep, leave that cancelled item out. Doesn't change the monthly test.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: My other status is unchanged: can't get to the stretch wrapper until production gives us a window. Still blocked, not starting it today.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, there's no window agreed. Nothing new to promise on that in this meeting.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Fair enough. Just didn't want the silence to sound like it was finished.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Next one, Marc, can you schedule downtime for the GT1 compressor with production? Normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: I can't take that one as well, sorry. With the test work already agreed, the scheduling needs to go to someone else.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay. Jamie, can you take over scheduling downtime for the GT1 compressor with production instead? Still normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll take that over. I'll schedule downtime for the GT1 compressor with production.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Just so we're not bundling things together there—that's arranging the downtime, not owning the permit and isolation as well?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Correct, just the downtime scheduling. I'm not taking the permit or isolation with it.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Which does still need doing: sort the permit to work and isolation for the GT1 compressor this morning. That's a separate gap.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yes, normal priority for that, due this morning. Anyone able to take the permit to work and isolation?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Not me. I can't accept that alongside the Compressed Air Dryer function test.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: I can't take ownership of that one either, sorry.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, no owner for the GT1 compressor permit to work and isolation. It still needs doing this morning, normal priority, but it's unclaimed.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: And the other gap: we need to write up the near miss at the palletizer. That's not covered by the inspection sign-off.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Agreed, normal priority for the write-up. Anyone taking it?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: I can't take that one, sorry.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: I haven't got capacity to own it either. I'm flagging the gap, not volunteering.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, the near miss write-up stays unassigned. Nobody's taken it.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: That's the distinction I wanted. Inspection's already done; the account of the near miss isn't. Not another physical inspection.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Exactly. No repeat inspection being added.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: That was worth saying. These calls can make one thing sound like three things if the audio drops in the wrong place.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Or if everyone talks at once, which obviously we never do.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: No, we're incredibly—

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: —disciplined. Sorry. Couldn't resist.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, we're clear on what's accepted and what's still got no owner. I'm not counting silence as someone taking those gaps.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yep. All clear from me.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Same here. Finished items and the pushed-back belt replacement aren't new work.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good. That's us, then. Thanks, everyone.
